test_cases.input_text: Hi support, our webhook endpoint has been returning 502 Bad Gateway errors for the last 40 minutes whenever a user triggers a sync. Can you check your EU-West servers?
test_cases.expected_summary_gist: The user reports persistent 502 Bad Gateway errors on their webhook endpoint during syncs on EU-West servers.
test_cases.notes: Hand-crafted technical incident email to balance technical category.

test_cases.input_text: The mobile app crashes immediately on iOS 19.1 every time I tap the 'Export PDF' button. Reinstalling didn't help.
test_cases.expected_summary_gist: The customer's iOS mobile app crashes consistently when tapping the Export PDF button.

test_cases.input_text: Getting SSL_ERROR_RX_RECORD_TOO_LONG when connecting to api.example.com via Python requests. Did your TLS certificate expire?
test_cases.expected_summary_gist: The developer is encountering an SSL error when connecting to the API and asks if the TLS certificate expired.

test_cases.input_text: Search indexing in our workspace has been stuck at 0% since yesterday morning and newly uploaded docs aren't showing up.
test_cases.expected_summary_gist: Workspace search indexing is stuck at 0%, preventing newly uploaded documents from appearing.

test_cases.input_text: CSV bulk import fails silently with no error toast when the file exceeds 5,000 rows.
test_cases.expected_summary_gist: Bulk CSV imports fail silently without an error message for files larger than 5,000 rows.

test_cases.input_text: Our SSO SAML assertion is throwing an InvalidAudience error after your dashboard update last night.
test_cases.expected_summary_gist: SSO SAML authentication is failing with an InvalidAudience error following a recent dashboard update.
test_cases.notes: Tests distinction between SSO configuration bug (technical) vs. simple user password reset (account).

test_cases.input_text: Dark mode charts render white text on a white background in Safari 18, making all metrics unreadable.
test_cases.expected_summary_gist: Dark mode charts display unreadable white-on-white text in Safari 18.

test_cases.input_text: Rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Remaining) are returning negative numbers on our Enterprise API key.
test_cases.expected_summary_gist: API rate limit headers are returning negative values for an Enterprise API key.

test_cases.input_text: 500 error
test_cases.expected_summary_gist: The user is reporting a 500 server error with no additional details.
test_cases.notes: Edge case: extremely short 2-word email testing concise summarization without hallucinating details.

test_cases.input_text: Oh brilliant, I LOVE getting charged $299 twice in one morning! Best Tuesday ever. Fix this before I call my bank.
test_cases.expected_summary_gist: The customer is sarcastically reporting a duplicate $299 charge and demanding an immediate fix.
test_cases.notes: Edge case: heavy sarcasm masking a duplicate charge billing complaint.

test_cases.input_text: Hola team, my invoice #9921 shows the wrong VAT number—por favor update it and send a corrected PDF.
test_cases.expected_summary_gist: The customer requests a corrected PDF for invoice #9921 with an updated VAT number.
test_cases.notes: Edge case: mixed English/Spanish language email.

test_cases.input_text: I can't log into my account because 2FA SMS codes aren't arriving, AND I noticed you billed me yesterday while I'm locked out. Please unlock my login first so I can check my workspace.
test_cases.expected_summary_gist: The user is locked out due to missing 2FA SMS codes and wants login access restored first while also noting a recent charge.
test_cases.notes: Edge case: dual-category ambiguity (account + billing) testing primary action tie-breaker rule.

test_cases.input_text: Hey! Quick question—do you offer non-profit discounts if we decide to upgrade to the Team plan next quarter?
test_cases.expected_summary_gist: The user is inquiring whether non-profit pricing discounts are available for a future Team plan upgrade.
test_cases.notes: Edge case: pricing/discount inquiry testing boundary between billing and general.

test_cases.input_text: Our production database sync has been completely down for 3 hours causing data loss! Also, where can I download last month's receipt?
test_cases.expected_summary_gist: The customer reports a 3-hour production database sync outage causing data loss and also asks where to download last month's receipt.
test_cases.notes: Edge case: critical technical outage paired with minor billing question.
